definitions.full: H2582. Chenadad חֵנָדָד proper name, masculine ( חֵן + הָדָד favour of Hadad ) — Levite chief Ezra 3:9 ; Neh 3:18 , 24 ; 10:10 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 2580 and 1908 ; favor of Hadad;

occurrences.englishText: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.
After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.
After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.
